newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Monday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Monday:

Spokesman Thierry Daman said Commissioner Hans van den Broek would hold a joint news conference with MEPs Leo Tindemans and Simone Veil on the release of the book "Unfinished peace" at 1215/1115 GMT on Tuesday.
Spokesman Filippo di Robilant said Commissioner Emma Bonino had called on the Kigali government to ensure the urgent opening of humanitarian corridors.

In answer to a question, di Robilant said the heads of states of the countries involved in the Great Lakes crisis would meet in Nairobi on Tuesday and that a ministerial meeting would take place on this issue between EU member states and relevant international agencies in Brussels on Thursday.
Di Robilant also said any intervention in the region for humanitarian reasons would be difficult without a U.N. Security Council resolution.

Spokesman Patrick Child said the Commission and EU statistics office Eurostat's director general Yves Franchet had not yet decided whether there would be a technical briefing on last Thursday's approval of a French decision to use a transfer of funds from France Telecom to reduce its 1997 budget deficit.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/972: Great Lakes crisis: Commissioner Emma Bonino calls on the Kigali government to ensure the safety of civilian populations and for the urgent opening of supply routes.
- IP/96/975: Commissioner Van Miert links DT's new business users tariffs to comprehensive networks access.
- IP/96/976: Commission authorizes the acquisition of Mercantile & General Reinsurance Company by Schweizer Ruckversicherungs-Gesellschaft.
- Speech/96/268: Speech by Commissioner Joao de Deus Pinheiro at the General Assembly of the European Confederation of Wood Industries.
- Programme of the European Conference on rural development "Rural Europe - future perspectives".
- Collection of Commission decisions on state aids - 1964-1995.
